verdict.rationale: The pack documents filing procedures, searchable databases (docs-12) and single-company RNE attestations (docs-18), but none of these is a bulk dataset or registry-extract download. The probe confirms only that an open-data portal exists at data.inpi.fr and that it returns 403 without an account-issued token. There is no documented bulk download, dataset catalogue or extract format, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
